blocks.text: In today's competitive market, businesses must effectively communicate their products to consumers. This is where advertising and sales promotion come into play.

blocks.markdown: Advertising is a paid form of communication that aims to inform and persuade potential customers about products or services. In Nigeria, common types of advertising include television, radio, print media (newspapers and magazines), and digital platforms (social media and websites). Each medium has its unique advantages and reaches different audiences.

blocks.title: Definition of Advertising
blocks.text: Advertising is a paid communication intended to inform or persuade an audience about products or services.

blocks.markdown: Sales promotion involves short-term incentives to encourage the purchase of a product or service. Examples include coupons, free samples, bonuses, and merchandising displays. These strategies are designed to boost immediate sales and can be very effective in attracting customers.

blocks.title: Understanding Sales Promotion
blocks.prompt: A local market in Lagos wants to increase sales of a new beverage. They decide to implement a sales promotion strategy. What are some effective methods they could use?

steps.text: 1. Offer coupons that provide a discount on the beverage.
2. Distribute free samples at local events to encourage trial.
3. Create attractive merchandising displays in stores to catch customers' attention.

blocks.answer: The market could effectively use coupons, free samples, and eye-catching displays to promote the new beverage.

blocks.markdown: While advertising can create brand awareness and attract customers, it has its merits and demerits. Merits include reaching a large audience and building brand image, while demerits may involve high costs and the potential for negative feedback.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: When answering questions on advertising, remember to mention both the types and media used in Nigeria for a comprehensive response.

points: Advertising is a paid communication method used to inform consumers.
Sales promotion offers short-term incentives to boost immediate sales.
Both advertising and sales promotion have distinct advantages and disadvantages.
